prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: DRAFT FOR OWNER REVIEW, one composite character identity sheet for the 2D CRPG Soul Meter. This explores unratified visual choices and establishes no canon.
Style/medium: gothic mythopunk; semi-realistic painted digital character illustration matching the Soul Meter Vex, Old Grumbrand, Korrath Ninefold and Ressa Quickfingers imagegen-source art: tactile worn materials, fine visible painterly grain, continuous tonal grade, believable volume and weight, muted Earth palette, charcoal and peat shadows, warm stone and cloth, restrained local accents. Like a painted classic CRPG character, never a flat graphic, UI icon, vector, cel cartoon, photograph or clean 3D render.
Lighting: single directional key light from upper-left with rich continuous shaded falloff; readable silhouettes, no pure-black outline. Background: opaque neutral mid-grey parchment, subtly textured, no environment, no transparent or checkerboard or green-screen ground.
Output: ONE composite PNG in landscape orientation, largest native landscape resolution the tool supports, full resolution. Keep all subjects fully inside margins with feet visible. No panels resembling UI. No lettering, captions, numbers, pseudo-writing, logos, watermarks or music notation, except the single word PROVISIONAL beside the scale bar on race sheets only. No bright generic high fantasy, no chibi/cartoon proportions, no flat lighting, no steampunk-dominant costume, no firearms, no Age-of-Stars machines, no Hollow bodies. Do not depict any deity. No extra image.
Composition: five clearly separated full-body painted studies across one wide sheet, all the same adult and with matching anatomy, proportion and ground line. From left to right: healthy FRONT view, healthy THREE-QUARTER view at a gently elevated isometric-adjacent angle, healthy BACK view, WANING-TOUCHED state in three-quarter view, and DOM WORKER clothing variant. The first three form a clean turnaround, wearing only modest simple undyed sleeveless fitted undershirt and knee-length work shorts so face, limbs, joints and surface remain visible. No class weapons, no armor, no patron regalia. The Dom variant wears practical repaired charcoal work layers, peat-brown leather apron/harness, iron fasteners and tough cloth leg wraps of an Iron Companies storm-port worker; adapt seams to the body, no weapons, no class kit, no invented company badge. Small separate scale inset at lower right: a plain unnumbered vertical scale bar beside a flat charcoal Vael adult reference silhouette and a silhouette of this race on the SAME baseline. The only text anywhere is PROVISIONAL once at that scale inset. Leave a generous clear gap around every study; prioritise visible anatomy over decoration.
Race: VAEL (Solan), the Certainty-Bearers. Author foundation: controlled form and tactile rigidity that loses stability with the Waning. This is NOT a crystal or machine species, no fixed canonical substrate and no assigned colour for acoustic B-flat.
The only exploratory anatomical choices on this sheet: silhouette tall upright and gently squared at shoulders; bodily substrate a living matte dermis arranged in broad taut fibrous tension planes (a tissue proposal, not stone, clay or crystal); facial structure broad planar brow and cheeks, shallow temples and compact rounded ears; proportions seven-and-a-half heads, moderate limbs, near-baseline breadth; surface palette muted warm clay-brown and cool grey-olive shadows; loss of rigidity shown in the fourth figure by softened cheeks and bowed forearms, slack shoulder planes and a subtly sagging stance while remaining a solid living person, no melting puddle, gore or spectral effects. Healthy version confidently holds straight weight-bearing planes. Short unobtrusive dark hair, no extra anatomical ornament. Scale inset: race height equals the Vael reference exactly, ratio 1.0, with no numerals.

REVISION REQUEST: Edit the supplied Vael sheet, keep the painted grain, light, identity, background and exactly five study layout. Crucial change: show living tissue's RIGIDITY, not merely a human getting tired. On healthy arms, shoulders and temples paint subtle broad linear fibrous tension ridges under a matte intact skin, never mineral plates. In the fourth figure show those same tissue planes visibly relaxed and bowed along both forearms, cheek and shoulder planes drooping softly while the living tissue remains intact. Do not give only a bent neck or sad face. Preserve the same adult identity. Correct the scale inset to TWO EXACTLY EQUAL-HEIGHT silhouettes with level tops and feet, both Vael, and a plain bar. The single label must read PROVISIONAL in uppercase. No other lettering or new features.
5. Avoid-list: pure-black outlines, flat/even lighting, cartoon/chibi proportions, bright
   generic high fantasy, steampunk-dominant material language, baked text/UI.
